description: Editable prompt configuration for one runtime purpose. Covers parametric templates (system + user with {{var}} placeholders), authoring AI prompts, and evaluation judges (which add an output_schema). The runtime substitutes {{var}} from a context dict; if the record is missing or disabled the hardcoded default under default_prompt/<purpose>.py is used.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.options:
llm_student
role_play
scenario_variant_generator
debrief
scenario_generator_ai
evaluation_schema_generator_ai
tutor
judge_persona
judge_coverage
judge_debrief
judge_difficulty
fields.description: Stable identifier looked up by the runtime. One record per purpose.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Free-text version tag. Bump on meaningful prompt changes for audit.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Uncheck to fall back to the hardcoded default.

fields.label: System Template
fields.description: Sent as the LLM `system` parameter after placeholder substitution. Use {{var}} for substitutions.

fields.label: User Template
fields.description: Sent as the user message after placeholder substitution. Use {{var}} for substitutions. Optional: prompts that only need a system message (e.g. role_play, judges) leave this empty.

fields.label: Output Schema (JSON)
fields.description: Optional JSON Schema enforced via response_format. Required only for evaluation judges (judge_persona/coverage/debrief/difficulty). Must remain compatible with the judge module's parse_output(): the LLM still has to produce score, summary, evidence_quotes, warnings, plus the dimension-specific extras the parser reads. Leave empty for runtime templates and authoring prompts.

fields.label: Available Placeholders
fields.description: List of {{var}} names the caller substitutes at runtime. Placeholders not listed here are left as literal text in the rendered prompt.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Free-text notes (e.g. change log, calibration runs).

name: LMSA Prompt Template
